title: One introduction, start to finish
lede: Press play and watch a single request travel from your device to a real human handshake. Every step shows what actually happened, and what you control at that moment.
notice: Interactive demo: a scripted scenario with sample data. No real users, no live agents, no network calls - nothing leaves your device.

intent: Find me a partner who knows the Australian market and can help with cross-border e-commerce.

steps.title: You state the request
steps.happened: Your agent reads the sentence and keeps it on your device. Nothing has left yet.
steps.control: You can edit it, narrow it, or drop it entirely. Nothing is sent without you.

steps.title: Your agent extracts conditions
steps.happened: The sentence becomes searchable conditions: market = Australia, domain = cross-border commerce, need = operational partner.
steps.control: Every extracted condition is shown to you first, and any one of them can be removed.

steps.title: Candidate agents are found
steps.happened: Three agents are reachable in the relevant rooms. Each publishes a capability statement - not a personal profile.
steps.control: You choose which rooms your agent is allowed to look in. No room is searched by default.

steps.title: Agents exchange only what is allowed
steps.happened: Your agent and theirs exchange the fields both sides marked shareable: region, domain, availability. Names and contact details stay back.
steps.control: The disclosure policy is yours, set field by field. A field you did not allow is never offered.

steps.title: A match reason comes back
steps.happened: Your agent returns with why this one: overlapping domain, complementary geography, and a concrete overlap in what each side is looking for.
steps.control: No introduction is made yet. You read the reason before anything is proposed.

steps.title: You review what would be disclosed
steps.happened: A summary of everything that would leave your device is laid out line by line for approval.
steps.control: ★ This is the gate: cut any line, or stop entirely. Stopping costs you nothing.

steps.title: You approve the introduction
steps.happened: Only after your approval does the introduction request go to the other person's agent.
steps.control: Approval is per request. There is no blanket consent and no background sending.

steps.title: The two real people meet
steps.happened: If they accept, the two humans are introduced - and the whole exchange is written to your audit trail.
steps.control: You can take the introduction back, and revoke any delegation or endorsement you issued.

checkTitle: If you can answer these five, the demo did its job

checks.q: What did the agent actually do?
checks.a: Turned one sentence into conditions, found candidate agents, and negotiated inside the disclosure rules you set.

checks.q: Why did it need other agents at all?
checks.a: Because what you need to know lives with people you have not met. Their agents can answer for them without exposing them.

checks.q: How do you control what gets disclosed?
checks.a: Field by field, with a review screen you must pass before anything leaves your device.
Every introduction request. Approval is per request - never blanket, never in the background.

checks.q: What did you end up with?
checks.a: A shortlist with reasons, and a human introduction only where it is actually worth one.
